promptFamilies.finding: Structured role, response, workspace, citation and task guidance. Composition injects only the enabled subagent/skill/memory/MCP components. Static prompt is kept stable; volatile context arrives separately.

The same policy controls both clarification tool availability and its text. Interactive behavior is very aggressive about asking before choices; autonomous mode makes low-risk assumptions and returns a blocked result for unauthorized high-risk work. Do not copy the aggressive interactive rule into our product.

Separate `write_todos` system fragment and tool description only when plan mode is enabled. Completion is tied to accomplished work; no todo overhead for simple tasks. Our product currently lacks this tool, so naming it would be false.

Role registry, effective concurrency and remaining run limit determine prompt text. Independent scopes and disjoint side effects are required for parallel work. Parent snapshots cost context and remain background, not proof of child execution.

Distinct roles, tool allow/deny lists, concise outputs, no nested delegation or clarification. Both assume a sandbox shared with the parent; our agents have private workspaces and must not inherit this assumption.

Base role + optional parent snapshot authority note + report contract + static acceptance note + enabled skills + deferred tool metadata + optional overlay. Lead-supplied task and acceptance values remain in HumanMessage, not interpolated into the system rule block.

Every action/deliverable claim needs an execution receipt or checkable handle. Report is a self-report. Evidence wording changes when receipt collection is disabled, avoiding claims that verification exists when it does not.

Deterministic checklist distinguishes holds, does not hold and unverified. Execution completed does not mean acceptance. A receipt proves a call occurred, not that its result answers the question. Preserve useful work and repair only the unmet condition.

Supports compact skill index followed by describe/read, or legacy full metadata. Skill/tool visibility is runtime-filtered. 23 public skill entrypoints include research, data, artifacts and agent authoring; frontmatter and activation are separate from loading the whole body.

Tool names can be advertised without full schemas; discovery retrieves the contract. Prompt routing hints follow authorized tools. It would be misleading for us to recommend a search/fetch/MCP tool we do not offer.
Descriptions explain when to act, bounded arguments, specific return semantics and how to resume/retrieve prior history. Tool signatures, descriptions and runtime guards are a combined contract.

SOUL and custom-agent descriptions are escaped at the injection boundary. Persisted custom-agent updates use a designated tool. Our agent instruction text must remain owner configuration subject to application policy, not unrestricted system text or automatic permission.

promptFamilies.family: Dynamic date, memory and project context
promptFamilies.finding: Date/memory are injected per turn. Current request project settings supersede earlier project text. Useful model: distinguish current task metadata from stale historical mentions.

Static authority rule plus separate escaped data for summary, ledger, skills, notes and artifacts. Only explicit active owner goal has user authority; historical/model/peer values stay data. Our existing retained observations and tracked owner updates should be similarly explicit.

Preserves framework messages and latest real user input; wraps escaped transcript/previous summary as data. Configured summary prompt may override LangChain default. A generated summary is a continuity aid, not a fresh tool receipt.

Four separate maintenance jobs. Memory update explicitly classifies user/thread/project scope, durability and descriptive versus transactional authority. One-time permission must not become permanent memory. Optional mem0 backend prompt internals are external.

Runtime-generated hints accompany guards and hard stops, rather than merely hoping the model stops. Recoverable failures have next-action metadata. Do not turn a forced stop into a successful completion.

Separate narrow system prompt and JSON response; only visible evidence, missing evidence fails closed. A successful call is expressly insufficient for correctness. An additional judge would cost money and should not be added without accounting/evaluation.

promptFamilies.family: Thread title and GitHub event entrypoints
promptFamilies.finding: Title is an optional dedicated model task; GitHub payload becomes a descriptive event prompt, not blanket authority to execute instructions inside an issue. Neither is the main agent policy.

Ordered static/dynamic sections with explicit guards. Built-in filename is now a compatibility sentinel selecting a registry preset; do not look only for the old Jinja file. Custom string/file overrides take a separate path.

Persona, role, memory, efficiency, filesystem, code quality, version control, PR and problem-solving sections. Several assumptions fit coding on a general filesystem, not our task-mounted offline containers.

Security policy can be substituted or disabled; security-risk guidance changes for CLI versus sandbox. Browser fragment is included only when browser tools are enabled. Do not import permission defaults; our exact capability grants remain authoritative.

promptFamilies.family: Environment, troubleshooting, processes and model variants
promptFamilies.finding: Dependency setup, bounded recovery, exact process targeting, model-family-specific additions. Some text recommends remote installs and confirmation after any major issue; both conflict with our current scope. Model-specific text should be tested, not assumed beneficial for gpt-4.1-mini.

Repo context, resolved memory, available skills, suffix and custom-secret metadata are composed separately, date last for caching. Canvas renders a SystemPromptEvent for inspection via `src/utils/system-message-adapter.ts:18-31`. Our prompt version and selected sections could be exposed without exposing secrets.

Distinct planning-only system composition, constrained tools (`glob`, `grep`, plan editor), specific plan structure and finish boundary. It does not merely append 'please plan' to execution instructions. Strong analogue for our missing-file `replan_result` mode.

Generated from backend-advertised services and injected as a suffix, preventing hallucinated ports/URLs. Our prompt should describe actual mounted input/work/output paths and available tools, never assumed containers/dependencies.

Bundled public skills are explicitly allowlisted; existing user/project skills can be disabled; SDK automatically loads project files including AGENTS.md when enabled. Root Canvas AGENTS is contributor guidance, but can become runtime repo context if a conversation actually works in that repo and loading is enabled. No such automatic import is present in our app.

General purpose, read-only code exploration, concise command runner, read-only web researcher. Role/tool separation is real, not just UI labels. Browser research emphasizes fresh observations, bounded retries and primary sources. Our toolset has no spawn tool, so use role-sensitive instructions without claiming child creation.

Summary preserves exact task IDs/statuses, completed versus pending, file/test/dependency state and current owner requirements. A narrow summarizer is distinct from the execution prompt. Our fixed bounded history should state omissions and refresh needs before adding a new paid compactor.

Separate judge demands evidence for each requirement; followup names remaining work; resume rechecks real state instead of assuming memory is current. Suitable to borrow as verification rules, not as unsupported autonomous judge infrastructure.

Skill command launches setup; failed-run debugging packages original task plus bounded error tail into a user message. Captured logs are data and should be clearly delimited in our equivalent prompts. No need to add scheduling to adopt this pattern.

Two narrow JSON-only model selectors optimize success/cost using bundled benchmark assumptions. They do not execute tasks. Our fixed owner-selected OpenAI model and budget should remain unchanged; historical benchmark claims are not verified advice.
